WITH query AS (SELECT replace(plainto_tsquery('russian'::regconfig,$1)::text,' & ',' | ')::tsquery AS q,tsvector_to_array(to_tsvector('russian'::regconfig,$1)) AS terms),scoped AS (SELECT snapshot_id,chunk_id,payload,search_vector FROM evidence_chunks WHERE snapshot_hash=$2::jsonb->>snapshot_id AND source_id=ANY($3::text[]) AND territory_ids && $4::text[] AND ($5::text[] IS NULL OR source_id=ANY($5)) AND ($6::date IS NULL OR valid_to>=$6) AND ($7::date IS NULL OR valid_from<=$7) AND ($8::date IS NULL OR valid_to>=$8) AND ($9::date IS NULL OR valid_from<=$9)),total AS (SELECT count(*)::float8 AS n FROM scoped),df AS (SELECT u.term,count(*)::float8 AS n FROM scoped CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(tsvector_to_array(scoped.search_vector)) AS u(term),query WHERE u.term=ANY(query.terms) GROUP BY u.term),scores AS (SELECT s.snapshot_id,s.chunk_id,sum(ln((total.n+1)/(df.n+0.5))) AS score FROM scoped s CROSS JOIN total CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(tsvector_to_array(s.search_vector)) AS u(term) JOIN df ON df.term=u.term GROUP BY s.snapshot_id,s.chunk_id) SELECT s.payload,sc.score,ts_rank_cd(s.search_vector,query.q) AS rank FROM scores sc JOIN scoped s USING (snapshot_id,chunk_id) CROSS JOIN query WHERE s.search_vector @@ query.q ORDER BY sc.score DESC,rank DESC,s.snapshot_id,s.chunk_id LIMIT 6
